reference_role: evaluator-side secondary context only; underconstrained projects were not judged by shape similarity
artifact_identity_rule: Only exact project_runtime_id + revision_id links from persisted development run records were used; filenames/project titles alone were not used.
hard_constraint_guardrail: CQ quality is independent of hard verification; CQ3 does not imply final completion and explicit hard constraints remain unverified unless persisted evidence proves them.
